items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Alfredito Valdes joined the band after Cheo Jimenez died.

ctx.x: No, we worked together at the Miguel Zavayas, he was the bass player. Another first voice was El Mejicano and then Alfredito Valdes went to the Sexteto Nacional; and Panchito Riset, that the the place for Alfredito Valdes ...
I see. Okay, Alfredito Valdes joined the band after Cheo Jimenez died.
